meta.scope: Syria Batch 4 — Education disruption, health/nutrition, and territorial control densification under extremely constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Education disruption and out-of-school statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from UNICEF and education monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics and framing of education access under conflict and recovery. Approximately 2.45 million children are out of school; thousands of schools remain non-functional. Continuously cited in humanitarian and human-capital analysis.
candidates.notes: Core education densification under severe conflict disruption.

candidates.title: Health access and nutrition statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from UNICEF / WHO and humanitarian sources
candidates.description: Statistics on health-service access and malnutrition. Large shares of the population require nutrition support; hundreds of thousands of children under five are affected by life-threatening malnutrition. Health-system functionality remains severely constrained.
candidates.notes: Core health and nutrition densification under humanitarian emergency conditions.

candidates.title: Territorial control and transitional-authority framing
candidates.description: Framing of post-Assad territorial and institutional landscape. A transitional government has expanded control over large areas previously held by the former regime; residual zones of influence (including SDF-held areas) persist. Continuously cited in security, reconstruction and external-engagement analysis.
candidates.notes: High-centrality structural frame for the post-conflict political and security landscape.

candidates.title: Syria education–health–territorial densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from education, health and conflict monitoring sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding education disruption, health/nutrition statistics, and territorial/transitional-authority framing into a coherent human-capital and political-security residual layer under extremely constrained conditions.
